page.layout: One column, centred, title page. Printed lines run from the top of the page to the imprint at the foot. Below the title lines is a woodcut seal with a motto around its rim. Below the seal, a rule, then the imprint in three lines. No running head, page number or signature.
page.notes: Woodcut seal below the title, with a banded motto around the rim. The motto is partly legible (fragments such as "VIRTVS" and "SINE FORTVNA") and is not transcribed. Handwriting at the top right ("b. 2") is a library annotation and is left out. The title's "VVest" is printed as VV for W and is kept as printed. The "PELA." line ends with a printed stop that stands in for the hyphen of the word.
